tasks.label: build
tasks.command: cmake -S . -B build/debug -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build/debug && ln -sf build/debug/compile_commands.json compile_commands.json

tasks.label: wait for the exchange
tasks.command: for i in $(seq 300); do (exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/12345) 2>/dev/null && exit 0; sleep 0.1; done; echo 'the exchange did not open port 12345 within 30 seconds'; exit 1
